name: atlas-workflow
description: Atlas workflow plugin for bounded local Codex work.

interface.shortDescription: Atlas entry plugin for bounded workflow, native $atlas-workflow:team, legacy $atlas-workflow:team-v1, and related planning skills
interface.longDescription: Adds Atlas workflow, task, grilling-style intake, office-hours, brainstorm, analyze, clarify, native team, legacy team-v1, learning, design-review, worktree, and finish entrypoints as local plugin skills so `$atlas-workflow:cw`, `$atlas-workflow:task`, `$atlas-workflow:intake`, `$atlas-workflow:office-hours`, `$atlas-workflow:brainstorm`, `$atlas-workflow:analyze`, `$atlas-workflow:clarify`, `$atlas-workflow:team`, `$atlas-workflow:team-v1`, `$atlas-workflow:learn`, `$atlas-workflow:design-review`, `$atlas-workflow:worktree`, and `$atlas-workflow:finish` stay available even when custom slash prompts are unavailable. Use `$atlas-workflow:intake` for grill, grilling, stress-test, and pressure-test requests before building.
defaultPrompt: 生成项目文档、workflow artifacts、交接材料和面向用户总结时，默认使用中文，除非用户明确要求其他语言

Keep Atlas phase evidence concise: git keeps phase conclusion files and final deliverables; raw logs, Playwright JSON, traces, videos, HAR, bulk screenshots, full command output, debug JSONL, API dumps, port status, and intermediate repair output stay in temporary run directories by default

Classify Atlas process docs: durable handoff and phase conclusion files may enter git; intake, clarify drafts, analysis, team rounds, loop ledgers, and repair notes stay as workflow working notes unless their confirmed summary is promoted
Use codex-workflow scaffold-intake, scaffold-brainstorm, scaffold-clarify, scaffold-team, and scaffold-phase before filling Atlas workflow artifacts
Use $atlas-workflow:task for bounded implementation or diagnosis
Use $atlas-workflow:intake to grill, stress-test, or pressure-test a plan one decision at a time before building
Use $atlas-workflow:clarify before execution when boundaries are unclear
Use $atlas-workflow:team for Codex native subagent collaboration; use $atlas-workflow:team-v1 only for legacy CLI-backed team-start/team-loop behavior
